name: Accordion
description: Stacked disclosure sections with one or several open at a time.

items.description: Sections in order; an item without a unique string `value`, or a group or separator, is dropped with a report.

icon.description: Decorative icon (an icon name or a node) at the start of every trigger; `item.icon` overrides it.

expanded.description: Values of the open sections (controlled); values without a section are kept for items that arrive later.

defaultExpanded.description: Values of the sections open on mount (uncontrolled); later changes are ignored.

multiple.description: Lets several sections stay open; when false, opening one closes the other and only the first open value shows.

collapsible.description: Lets the user close the last open section; when false its trigger is `aria-disabled` while open.

disabled.description: Disables every trigger; panel contents keep their own interactivity.

headingLevel.description: The `aria-level` of every trigger's heading, an integer from 1 to 6.

behavior.stateModel: expanded/defaultExpanded/onExpandedChange hold the open section values; values without a section are kept and not shown.
behavior.multiple: By default, opening one item keeps already open items expanded. Set multiple=false to force single-open behavior.
behavior.collapsible: When collapsible=false, the last open item cannot be closed by toggling it.

Tab.condition: every enabled trigger is in the tab sequence

notes: Triggers are native buttons; content panels are hidden when collapsed.
Accordion intentionally uses shared control geometry and motion tokens instead of accordion-local size or timing tokens.
Item icons reuse Button icon semantics: string names resolve through Icon, React nodes render directly, and left-icon triggers use --uf-control-pad-icon.
Content panels keep full slot width so nested controls retain their own system insets and full-width behavior.
Trigger labels and content strings route through Text; nested action content should remain Face UI or UF components.

whenToUse: Long content that needs progressive disclosure
whenNotToUse: Simple show/hide toggle without grouped content
